reason: E2 supports that nonequilibrium SRO states can form during processing, but none of the cited evidence addresses SRO evolution during thermal exposure, its effect on intermetallic nucleation barriers, or the link to corrosion/oxidation resistance in Mg-containing alloys. E1 discusses Mn depletion and oxidation in a different alloy system without SRO, and E3 only mentions as-cast structures without SRO or degradation mechanisms.
